title: Apparel and Footwear Returns
text: Apparel and footwear can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

title: Apparel and Footwear Returns
text: The product should be unused, unwashed, and have its original tags and packaging intact.

title: Apparel and Footwear Returns
text: Items that show signs of use or damage caused after delivery may not be eligible for return.

title: Electronics Returns
text: Eligible electronics can generally be returned within 10 days of delivery.

title: Electronics Returns
text: The product should include its original accessories, manuals, packaging, and other items supplied with the product.

title: Electronics Returns
text: Certain electronics may have replacement-only policies depending on the seller or product category.

title: Damaged or Defective Products
text: If a product arrives damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered, the customer should report the issue as soon as possible through the order support option.

title: Damaged or Defective Products
text: Customers may be asked to provide photographs, videos, or other information to verify the issue.

title: Order Cancellation
text: An order can be cancelled before it enters the shipping process, subject to the cancellation status shown for the order.

title: Order Cancellation
text: Once an order has been shipped, cancellation may no longer be available.

title: Order Cancellation
text: If cancellation is unavailable after shipping, the customer may need to follow the applicable return process after delivery.

title: Refund Processing
text: Refunds are initiated after the returned product has been received and the return is processed successfully.

title: Refund Processing
text: The time taken for the refund to appear depends on the payment method and the customer's bank or payment provider.

title: Cash on Delivery Refunds
text: For eligible Cash on Delivery orders, refunds may require the customer to provide valid bank account or other supported payment details.

title: Cash on Delivery Refunds
text: The refund is processed after the return has been received and approved.

title: Prepaid Order Refunds
text: For eligible prepaid orders, refunds are normally processed back to the original payment method or another supported method as specified during the refund process.

title: Prepaid Order Refunds
text: Processing time can vary depending on the payment provider.

title: Exchange Policy
text: An exchange may be available for eligible products when the product, seller, and order qualify for exchange.

title: Exchange Policy
text: Exchange availability can depend on product category, size or variant availability, and the seller's policy.

title: Delivery Delays
text: Delivery dates are estimates and may change because of weather, logistics conditions, high order volumes, or other operational issues.

title: Delivery Delays
text: Customers can check the latest delivery status and estimated date from the order tracking page.

title: Missing Items
text: If an order is delivered with an item missing, the customer should report the issue through the order support process.

title: Missing Items
text: The support team may request information about the package and its contents before resolving the issue.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: If the customer receives a product different from the product ordered, the issue should be reported through the order support option.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: The customer may be asked to provide photographs of the product, packaging, and shipping label for verification.

title: Return Pickup
text: For eligible returns, a return pickup may be scheduled based on the customer's location and available logistics service.

title: Return Pickup
text: The pickup date shown in the order may change depending on courier availability and operational conditions.

title: Non-Returnable Products
text: Some products may not be eligible for return because of their category, hygiene requirements, personalization, or seller-specific restrictions.

title: Non-Returnable Products
text: The product page and order details should be checked to determine the applicable return eligibility.

title: Product Eligibility for Return
text: Return eligibility depends on the product category, seller policy, condition of the product, and the return window.

title: Product Eligibility for Return
text: Customers should check the return information displayed on the product page or order details before requesting a return.
